title: Why do we yawn?
hook: Hi friends! When I am sleepy my mouth opens really wide. Why do we yawn?
answer: A yawn is a big, slow breath in and out. When we feel sleepy or bored, our brain gets a little warm and slow. A yawn pulls in cool air and stretches the muscles in our face and chest. It is like opening a window to let fresh air into a stuffy room.
wowFact: Here is a wow fact! Yawns are catching. When you see a friend yawn, you often yawn too.
experiment: Try this! Look at a grown-up and do a big, slow pretend yawn. Now wait and watch quietly. Did the grown-up yawn back? Try it on a friend too.

onScreenText.answer: A big breath to wake up the brain
onScreenText.experiment: Try it: fake a yawn and watch

description: Bolt discovers why we yawn when we are sleepy and why yawns seem to spread from person to person. Then he tries a fun yawn experiment on a grown-up.
